Messages.Author: Talo...@hotmail.com
Messages.Body:
The new rulebook says that past vampires called 'non-camarilla' are
independent.

But what do cards that effect 'non-camarilla' vampires do? (judgement
camarilla segregation, protect thine own etc.), do these cards effect
all vampires that arent camarilla, or just the independents, or no one
now??

T

Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:


They affect all vampires that aren't Camarilla.
Any vampire who is not Camarilla is non-Camarilla.
Any vampire who is not Sabbat is non-Sabbat.
